sources.note: The survey record describes continuous mouse-driven plane flight through a 3D scene and world-space collection of targets.
No source code or presentation assets are copied; the repository is provenance only.

transformation.description: An original procedural cloud landscape, mail plane, delivery-seal geometry, perspective projection, steering loop, contact replay, and two input surfaces were implemented from first principles.

boundaries: The benchmark preserves the source-supported flight, depth, off-view search, heading correction, and collect-all loop without reproducing source code or branded assets.
Targets are collected only by replayed plane/target distance in the shared 3D world; screen overlap is not accepted.
The public browser surface is visual exploration, not a secret evaluation surface; local grading independently replays the submitted event ledger.
